Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000345": During INC-2025-011, the ledger saw write latency spike tenfold for an hour on 2025-04-26.  (about: ledger, INC-2025-011)
- memory_id "1000341": Team Atlas flagged on 2025-04-18 that the catalog service's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change.  (about: Team Atlas, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000338" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the ledger deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger)
- memory_id "1000332": As of the 2025-04-16 rotation, Lena carries the Team Boreal on-call pager.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena)
- memory_id "1000327": The catalog service relies on the resizer for thumbnails, so if the resizer is down, the catalog service is down.  (about: catalog service, resizer)
- memory_id "1000307": The catalog service's joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000305" [decision]: As of 2025-04-04, the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000283": As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service.  (about: Team Boreal, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000267": As of 2025-03-28, the pager for the webhooks service rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Boreal, webhooks service)
- memory_id "1000261" [constraint]: The catalog service only ships on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000254": As of 2025-03-20, Team Dune owns the catalog service.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000250": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000225": As of 2025-03-17, the billing service lives with Team Boreal.  (about: Team Boreal, billing service)
- memory_id "1000201": The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents.  (about: catalog service, indexer)
- memory_id "1000196": On 2025-02-27, Team Boreal noticed the feature-flags service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Boreal, feature-flags service)
- memory_id "1000180": Team Cinder flagged that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade.  (about: Team Cinder, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000156": During INC-2025-004, a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000154": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000082": Lena takes the first Boreal on-call shift of the year.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena)
- memory_id "1000011": As of January 2025, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Team Boreal, Lena, Marcus)
Existing entity names: ledger, INC-2025-011, Team Atlas, catalog service, Team Boreal, Lena, resizer, auth gateway, webhooks service, Team Dune, Team Cinder, billing service, indexer, feature-flags service, INC-2025-004, Marcus
